query:
WITH pi AS (
             SELECT id, "itemId", position, "addedById" FROM playlist_items WHERE "playlistId" = $1 AND $7::int[] IS NULL
             UNION ALL
             SELECT t.i, t.i, (t.n - 1)::int, NULL::int FROM unnest($7::int[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(i, n)
           )
           SELECT pi.id AS "item_id!", pi."itemId" AS "track_item!", (m.type = 'album') AS "is_track!",
                  pi.position AS "position!", pi."addedById" AS added_by_id,
                  jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', m.id, 'createdAt', m."createdAt", 'updatedAt', m."updatedAt", 'title', m.title,
                    'originalTitle', m."originalTitle", 'year', m.year, 'type', m.type, 'overview', m.overview,
                    'status', m.status, 'monitored', m.monitored, 'preferredProvider', m."preferredProvider",
                    'folderName', m."folderName", 'posterUrl', m."posterUrl",
                    'metadataRefreshedAt', m."metadataRefreshedAt", 'fanartUrl', m."fanartUrl",
                    'rating', m.rating, 'genres', m.genres, 'runtime', m.runtime, 'libraryId', m."libraryId",
                    'languageProfileId', m."languageProfileId", 'addedById', m."addedById",
                    'alternativeTitles', m."alternativeTitles", 'additionalFanartUrls', m."additionalFanartUrls",
                    'logoUrl', m."logoUrl") || jsonb_build_object(
                    'tmdbId', ids.tmdb, 'imdbId', ids.imdb, 'tvdbId', ids.tvdb,
                    'tmdbCollectionId', coll.tmdb_id, 'tmdbCollectionName', coll.name,
                    'releaseDate', dates.release_date, 'inCinemas', dates.cinema_date,
                    'digitalRelease', dates.digital_date, 'physicalRelease', dates.physical_date,
                    'qualityProfileId', w."qualityProfileId", 'minimumAvailability', w."minimumAvailability") AS "media!: Jsonb<Value>",
                  jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'createdAt', l."createdAt", 'updatedAt', l."updatedAt",
                    'name', l.name, 'icon', l.icon, 'color', l.color, 'mediaTypes', l."mediaTypes",
                    'preferredProvider', l."preferredProvider", 'path', df.path, 'label', NULL,
                    'metadataLanguage', l."metadataLanguage", 'metadataRegion', l."metadataRegion",
                    'defaultQualityProfileId', l."defaultQualityProfileId",
                    'defaultLanguageProfileId', l."defaultLanguageProfileId") AS "library!: Jsonb<Value>",
                  CASE WHEN q.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', q.id, 'createdAt', q."createdAt", 'updatedAt', q."updatedAt", 'name', q.name,
                    'cutoff', q.cutoff, 'items', q.items, 'upgradeAllowed', q."upgradeAllowed",
                    'resolutionUpgradeOnly', q."resolutionUpgradeOnly",
                    'minCustomFormatScore', q."minCustomFormatScore") END AS "quality: Jsonb<Value>",
                  CASE WHEN lp.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', lp.id, 'createdAt', lp."createdAt", 'updatedAt', lp."updatedAt", 'name', lp.name,
                    'audioLanguages', lp."audioLanguages", 'subtitleLanguages', lp."subtitleLanguages") END
                    AS "language: Jsonb<Value>",
                  CASE WHEN md.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', md.id, 'createdAt', md."createdAt", 'updatedAt', md."updatedAt", 'budget', md.budget,
                    'revenue', md.revenue, 'tagline', md.tagline, 'popularity', md.popularity,
                    'voteCount', md."voteCount", 'originalLanguage', md."originalLanguage",
                    'productionCountries', md."productionCountries", 'productionCompanies', md."productionCompanies",
                    'videos', md.videos, 'keywords', md.keywords)
                  WHEN sd.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', sd.id, 'createdAt', sd."createdAt", 'updatedAt', sd."updatedAt", 'budget', NULL,
                    'revenue', NULL, 'tagline', sd.tagline, 'popularity', sd.popularity,
                    'voteCount', sd."voteCount", 'originalLanguage', sd."originalLanguage",
                    'productionCountries', sd."productionCountries", 'productionCompanies', sd."productionCompanies",
                    'videos', sd.videos, 'keywords', sd.keywords) END AS "metadata: Jsonb<Value>",
                  CASE WHEN e."groupId" IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', e.id, 'createdAt', e."createdAt", 'updatedAt', e."updatedAt",
                    'episodeNumber', e."number", 'endEpisodeNumber', e."endNumber", 'title', e.title,
                    'overview', e.overview, 'airDate', e."airDate", 'runtime', e.runtime,
                    'monitored', e.monitored, 'hasFile', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_parts ip WHERE ip."itemId" = e.id), 'stillUrl', e."stillUrl",
                    'markersScannedAt', e."markersScannedAt", 'seasonId', e."groupId") END AS "episode: Jsonb<Value>",
                  CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', s.id, 'createdAt', s."createdAt", 'updatedAt', s."updatedAt",
                    'seasonNumber', s."number", 'monitored', s.monitored,
                    'preferredProvider', s."preferredProvider", 'mediaId', s."mediaId",
                    'posterUrl', s."posterUrl", 'overview', s.overview, 'airDate', s."airDate") END AS "season: Jsonb<Value>",
                  ps.completed AS "completed?", ps."positionSeconds" AS "position_seconds?",
                  ps."durationSeconds" AS duration_seconds
           FROM pi
           JOIN items e ON e.id = pi."itemId"
           JOIN media m ON m.id = e."mediaId" AND m.type = ANY($8)
           JOIN libraries l ON l.id = m."libraryId" AND l.id = ANY($2)
           LEFT JOIN library_default_folders df ON df."libraryId" = l.id
           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(value) FILTER (WHERE provider = $4)::int AS tmdb,
             max(value) FILTER (WHERE provider = $5)::int AS tvdb,
             max(value) FILTER (WHERE provider = $6) AS imdb
           FROM media_external_ids WHERE "mediaId" = m.id) ids ON true
           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(date) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'cinema') AS cinema_date,
                        max(date) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'digital') AS digital_date,
                        max(date) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'physical') AS physical_date,
                        max(date) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'release') AS release_date
                      FROM media_release_dates WHERE "mediaId" = m.id AND "editionId" IS NULL) dates ON true
           LEFT JOIN wants w ON w."mediaId" = m.id AND w.family = 'video'
           LEFT JOIN quality_profiles q ON q.id = w."qualityProfileId"
           LEFT JOIN language_profiles lp ON lp.id = m."languageProfileId"
           LEFT JOIN movie_details md ON md."mediaId" = m.id
           LEFT JOIN series_details sd ON sd."mediaId" = m.id
           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.id AS cid, x.value::int AS tmdb_id, NULLIF(c.name, '') AS name
             FROM collection_entries e JOIN collections c ON c.id = e."collectionId"
             JOIN collection_external_ids x ON x."collectionId" = c.id AND x.provider = 'tmdb'
             WHERE e."mediaId" = m.id AND e."itemId" IS NULL ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1) coll ON true
           LEFT JOIN item_groups s ON s.id = e."groupId"
           LEFT JOIN playback_states ps ON ps."userId" = $3 AND ps."itemId" = pi."itemId"
           ORDER BY pi.position, pi.id
